n7e15cdc8afb.s: What share of global lithium processing is concentrated in a few countries?
n7e15cdc8afb.x: More than 70% of lithium processing (and most cobalt refining) is concentrated in a few countries, a supply-chain risk for battery makers.

n72e53a2ebe3.s: In a lithium-ion battery, graphite is generally used as the:
n72e53a2ebe3.x: Graphite is the anode of a lithium-ion battery; lithium, nickel and cobalt are used in the cathode.

n3c4e6c0171a.s: Under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022, which of the following is prohibited for producers?
o: Disposing of waste batteries in landfills
Using recycled material in new batteries
n3c4e6c0171a.x: Producers must collect, recycle or refurbish waste batteries and use recycled material; landfill disposal is prohibited.

n673f58e69e4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022?
o: They replaced the Batteries (Management and Handling) Rules, 2001
They permit incineration of waste batteries
They ban landfill disposal of waste batteries
n673f58e69e4.x: The Rules ban both landfill disposal and incineration of waste batteries, so permitting incineration is wrong.

n7c3ba733eb7.s: The CEA estimated India's energy storage requirement by 2029–30 at:
n7c3ba733eb7.x: CEA estimated a need of 336 GWh by 2029–30, against only about 500 MWh of BESS in September 2025.

n2e9ac5ca5d4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Energy Conservation Act, 2001 – Energy audits of designated consumers
Bureau of Energy Efficiency – Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Carbon Credit Trading Scheme – Original Energy Conservation Act, 2001
n2e9ac5ca5d4.x: The 2001 Act provides for energy audits of designated consumers (and penalties); BEE is under the Ministry of Power, ECO Niwas covers residential buildings and the CCTS basis came with the 2022 amendment.

nc31ee53a815.s: Under the Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act, 2022, designated consumers must use a minimum share of:
nc31ee53a815.x: The 2022 amendment requires designated consumers to use a minimum share of non-fossil energy.

ne2b7bf35732.s: The National Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency is one of how many missions under NAPCC (2008)?
ne2b7bf35732.x: NMEEE is one of the eight missions of the National Action Plan on Climate Change (2008).

n677a4c29d88.s: The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, which recognised India's CCTS, applies from:
n677a4c29d88.x: The UK CBAM applies from 1 January 2027; in September 2026 the UK recognised India's CCTS as a qualifying carbon price.

n110ef057cb9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about energy conservation observances and awards?
o: National Energy Conservation Day is observed on 14 December
National Energy Conservation Week is 14–20 December
The National Energy Conservation Awards are given by MNRE
The National Energy Conservation Awards were instituted in 1991
n110ef057cb9.x: NECA is given by BEE under the Ministry of Power, not by MNRE.

nb9a28eda080.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The Grameen Vitrak Yojana was launched in 2009
The Grameen Vitrak Yojana raised the rural share of LPG distributors from 18% to 60%
Surya Nutan is an indoor solar stove launched in 2022
Surya Nutan was developed by EESL
nb9a28eda080.x: Surya Nutan was developed by IOCL, not EESL.

n5372decc0e0.s: As per the latest figure, how many willing households were electrified under Saubhagya?
n5372decc0e0.x: Saubhagya electrified 2.86 crore willing households; 2.82 crore was an older figure (March 2021).

n74f4541667b.s: Andhra Pradesh provides free power to BPL SC/ST households up to how many units per month?
n74f4541667b.x: AP gives free power up to 200 units a month to eligible BPL SC/ST households; 300 units is the PM Surya Ghar limit.

new.s: Which battery stores liquid electrolytes in tanks, so that energy and power can be scaled separately?
new.x: Flow (vanadium) batteries keep liquid electrolytes in tanks and are used for grid-scale storage.

new.s: The electrolyte of a lead-acid battery is:
new.x: Lead-acid batteries use lead and PbO2 with sulphuric acid; KOH is the Ni-Cd electrolyte.

new.s: Which lithium-ion cathode chemistry is noted for being safe and long-lived?
new.x: LFP is the safe, long-life Li-ion cathode chemistry; NMC uses nickel, manganese and cobalt.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Solid-state batteries use a solid electrolyte; NiMH replaces cadmium with metal hydride, lead-acid uses sulphuric acid and zinc-carbon is not rechargeable.

new.s: KABIL has acquired lithium land in which country?
new.x: KABIL acquired lithium land in Argentina.

new.s: Marlagalla, a lithium find in Karnataka, is in which district?
new.x: Lithium has been found at Marlagalla in Mandya (Karnataka), besides Salal-Haimana in Reasi (J&K).

new.s: The PLI scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell batteries targets:
new.x: The ACC-PLI, approved on 12 May 2021, covers 50 GWh with an outlay of ₹18,100 crore.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the PLI scheme for ACC batteries:
1. It was approved on 12 May 2021.
2. Ola Electric was allotted 20 GWh.
3. Reliance was allotted 20 GWh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The scheme was approved on 12 May 2021 and Ola Electric got 20 GWh; Reliance got 15 GWh, not 20 GWh.

new.s: Which of the following gigafactory pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Ola Electric's gigafactory is at Krishnagiri (Tamil Nadu); Reliance's is at Jamnagar (Gujarat).

new.s: The Energy Storage Obligation of 2022 was issued by the:
new.x: The ESO was issued by the Ministry of Power in 2022; ACC-PLI is under Heavy Industries and battery rules under MoEFCC.

new.s: Compressed Air Energy Storage (CAES) works by:
o: Compressing air into caverns and expanding it through turbines
Storing energy as rotational kinetic energy
Pumping water uphill for release at peak
new.x: CAES compresses air into caverns and later expands it through turbines; a flywheel stores rotational kinetic energy.

new.s: Tehri PSP, India's first variable-speed pumped storage project, is located in:
new.x: Tehri PSP (4 x 250 MW) in Uttarakhand is India's first variable-speed pumped storage project.

new.s: PM E-DRIVE, introduced in 2024, replaced which scheme?
new.x: PM E-DRIVE replaced FAME-II in 2024.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about vehicle types?
o: A BEV runs on battery only
A PHEV combines an engine with a battery-motor
A plain HEV can be plugged in for charging
An FCEV runs on a hydrogen fuel cell
new.x: Only the PHEV plugs in; a plain HEV does not.

new.s: The Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 set a material recovery target of 90% by:
new.x: The Rules target 90% material recovery by 2026-27.

new.s: The Pinnapuram integrated solar, wind and pumped storage project is in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Pinnapuram (Greenko) is in Kurnool district.

new.s: The CEA storage plan for Andhra Pradesh (August 2026) envisages battery storage of about:
new.x: The plan has 3,931 MW of battery and 7,370 MW of pumped storage for AP.

new.s: The Energy Efficiency Implementation Readiness ranking (November 2016), in which Andhra Pradesh came first, was prepared by:
new.x: The World Bank (with EESL) prepared it; AP was first (42.01) and Rajasthan second.

new.s: In SEEI 2024, which State led the 5–15 Mtoe group?
new.x: AP led the 5–15 Mtoe group; Maharashtra (>15), Assam (1–5) and Tripura (<1) led the others.

new.s: Under the State Energy Efficiency Index, a 'Front Runner' State scores above:
new.x: SEEI categories are Front Runner (>60%), Achiever, Contender and Aspirant.

new.s: Which of the following is under the voluntary star-labelling list?
new.x: Industrial motors, computers and microwave ovens are voluntary; ceiling fans, refrigerators and tubular fluorescent lamps are mandatory.

new.s: BEE's Standards and Labelling programme was launched in:
new.x: The S&L programme was launched in 2006 and rates over 40 equipment on a 1–5 star scale.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about building codes:
1. ECBC (2007) covers new commercial buildings.
2. ECO Niwas Samhita covers commercial buildings.
3. ECSBC (2024) adds sustainability to the code.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: ECBC covers commercial buildings and ECSBC adds sustainability; ECO Niwas Samhita is for residential buildings.

new.s: PAT Cycle I (2012-15) covered:
new.x: PAT-I covered 478 units in 8 sectors; 208 units/9 industries is CCTS and 60 clusters/14 sectors is ADEETIE.

new.s: The SAKSHAM fuel-conservation campaign is run by:
new.x: SAKSHAM is run by the Petroleum Conservation Research Association (PCRA), not BEE.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an energy-conservation practice?
o: Using pressure cookers and lids while cooking
new.x: Incandescent bulbs lose most energy as heat; LEDs, star-rated appliances and switching off idle loads save energy.

new.s: The National Energy Conservation Awards were instituted in:
new.x: NECA was instituted in 1991 and is given by BEE under the Ministry of Power.

new.s: The main emitter material of an LED is:
new.x: Gallium arsenide is the main LED emitter; LEDs contain no mercury.

new.s: ADEETIE, the MSME energy-efficiency scheme, covers:
new.x: ADEETIE covers 60 clusters in 14 sectors; 478 units in 8 sectors is PAT Cycle I.

new.s: Under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001, energy-efficiency norms apply to buildings with a connected load above:
new.x: Norms apply to buildings with connected load over 100 kW or contract demand over 120 kVA.

new.s: Under UDAY, States took over what share of discom debt?
new.x: States took over 75% of discom debt: 50% in 2015-16 and 25% in 2016-17.

new.s: States participating in UDAY covered about what share of discom debt?
new.x: Participating States covered 97% of discom debt (APPSC 2017).

new.s: The outlay of the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS) is:
new.x: RDSS has an outlay of ₹3,03,758 crore; ₹75,021 crore is PM Surya Ghar.

new.s: Feeder separation of agricultural and non-agricultural feeders is a feature of:
new.x: DDUGJY separates agricultural and non-agricultural feeders and strengthens rural networks; IPDS is urban.

new.s: Under PM-KUSUM, Component B covers:
o: Grid-connected solar plants on farm land
new.x: Component B is standalone solar pumps; A is grid-connected plants and C is solarisation of grid-connected pumps.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PM-KUSUM?
o: It was launched in 2019 under MNRE
Component A covers grid-connected solar plants on farm or barren land
It covers urban household rooftop solar
Component C covers solarisation of grid-connected pumps
new.x: Urban household rooftop solar is under PM Surya Ghar, not PM-KUSUM.

new.s: The PM Surya Ghar target for Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: AP's target is 6 lakh households (6,000 per constituency).

new.s: About how many pumps have been solarised in Andhra Pradesh under PM-KUSUM?
new.x: AP has solarised 2.93 lakh pumps under PM-KUSUM.

new.s: The outlay of PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana is:
new.x: PM Surya Ghar has an outlay of ₹75,021 crore.
